messages:
ravi (SecOps): deploy-bot just flagged image redwood/api:release-20260321 — SBOM shows a missing license field for dep 'zlib-compat' and a transitive medium CVE (CVE-2025-1234) in a dev-only subdep.
deploy-bot: [scan result] image: redwood/api:release-20260321
  - sbom: license=UNKNOWN for zlib-compat
  - vuln: CVE-2025-1234 (medium) found in package 'transient-io' -> dev-utils -> zlib-compat
  - policy: FAIL (requires triage)
anya (Release): ugh. Is that transitive reachable at runtime or just in build/test artifacts?
ravi (SecOps): looks like build-time only, but the SBOM generator included the whole tree. runtime footprint should be fine, but legal wants license clarity before we ship EU region.
leo (Platform): can we produce a trimmed image fast (rebuild with --prod-only deps) or is it going to take hours?
emma (SRE): rebuild + full canary tests ~45-90m. If we patch now we'll miss the 10:00 change window.
sam (QA): regression risk is low for a rebuild that strips dev deps, but we need a smoke run against staging.
laura (Legal): we need an explanation in release notes for EU customers if license becomes unknown. If it's only in build tooling and not shipped, we can include an advisory instead of blocking. Can security confirm non-runtime?
ravi (SecOps): confirmed non-runtime by inspecting container layers and ldd checks. I'll attach the layer diff in a follow-up. For immediate action I propose: 1) Hold global canary, 2) Proceed with EU-limited canary (regional carveout) for 12h behind feature-flag, 3) Rebuild slim image and push as release-20260321-patch within the change window tomorrow, 4) Add advisory to release notes and mark license investigation ticket.
anya (Release): option 3 sounds safest. We can gate EU rollout via routing policy and disable external-integrations feature flag. That keeps Prod US unaffected.
leo (Platform): I can add a routing rule to only send traffic from eu-* regions to the new canary and set capacity to 5% of normal requests. I will also create a fallback to the previous model if errors spike.
deploy-bot: action created: deploy-control/4923456799 -> eu-canary:start, percent=5, duration=12h
emma (SRE): i'll keep oncall eyes open; if latency or errors >2% for 10m we rollback to previous image automatically.
laura (Legal): fine with advisory language. please include: "This release contains a non-runtime build tooling component with an unspecified license; no runtime impact expected. We are working to clarify the license and will patch if needed."
anya (Release): decision: proceed with EU-limited canary now, block global rollout until slim rebuild is validated. I'll update release notes and add a ticket: REL-5298 (investigate zlib-compat license & rebuild).
sam (QA): will run quick smoke once leo's routing is live.
ravi (SecOps): tagging follow-up: SEC-1256. I'll post the layer diff and a short script to reproduce the SBOM extraction to the thread in 10m.
anya (Release): thanks all. @deploy-bot leave the global rollout paused and notify #product and #support about the advisory once release notes are updated. :thumbsup:
